name: Jaroslav Novák
bio:
Jaroslav's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional, starting with a fascination for scale model cars and their intricate paint jobs. This passion led him to apprentice at a local auto body shop, where he honed his skills in paint application and color matching. His meticulous nature and keen eye for detail quickly made him a sought-after specialist in the region.

He joined Hitech Development five years ago, bringing a fresh perspective to their paint shop. Jaroslav is known for his unwavering commitment to achieving flawless finishes, even under tight deadlines. His demanding nature stems from his belief that the quality of the paint job is a reflection of the team's overall dedication, often pushing his team to deliver the best result possible. He is particularly skilled in creating custom paint schemes and working with specialized coatings, which has made him a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Jaroslav apart is his obsession with achieving the perfect shade and texture. He meticulously documents every paint batch and application technique, constantly seeking ways to improve the process and ensure consistent results.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, slightly receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height, Jaroslav always wears protective eyewear.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of microfiber cloth for final polishing.
Always listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Keeps a detailed logbook of every paint job, including mixing ratios and application techniques.
